title: Faculty at more than a dozen universities — Harvard, Stanford, Oxford, Cambridge among them — have taken Incorruptible up
summary: Eric marks the book's uptake in the academy, naming Harvard, Stanford, Oxford and Cambridge among more than a dozen universities where faculty have adopted it, and citing two of the academic endorsements the timeline already carries: Tara Ceranic Salinas at the University of San Diego and Rebecca Henderson at Harvard Business School.
blockquote: One of the most meaningful developments to me this fall has been the embrace of Incorruptible in the academy. Faculty at more than a dozen universities, from Harvard and Stanford to Oxford and Cambridge, and so many more, have taken it up.
